trap.label: during × while
trap.wrong: During the participants are tested, the staff stay silent.
trap.right: While the participants are tested, the staff stay silent.
trap.why: Em português “durante” aparece sem distinção diante de substantivo ou oração. Em inglês, during + substantivo; while + oração.

mcq.q: “___ the test, the staff stay silent.”

fix.wrong: During they are tested, notes are taken.
fix.right: While they are tested, notes are taken.

rewrite.prompt: Una com while: “Participants are tested. Staff take notes.” (While…)
rewrite.answer: While participants are tested, staff take notes.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com during: “While the test, staff stay silent.” (corrija)
rewrite.answer: During the test, staff stay silent.
